title: The saved technician order is shared by both views for each location
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission and Work Orders create-and-edit; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. Second device/browser available.
custom_steps:
1. Reorder work orders and technicians in Tech View.
  2. Switch to Board View and confirm the same manual order.
  3. Log out/in and open on a second device; confirm the manual order persists and is used instead of the initial sort.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Once anyone at the location has reordered a technician's work orders, that saved order is used instead of the initial sort; the manual order of work orders is saved once per location and everyone there sees the same order in both Tech View and Board View.
  • Technician group/column order is saved per user. If two people reorder at the same time, the later save wins; the other sees the saved order on next refresh and is not warned.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10052 — Drag to reorder work and technician groups/columns. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, PRD v33 (2026-09-28), requirement(s) S9-R3, S9-R11, S9-R12 (read 30 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R3: “Once anyone at the location has reordered a technician’s work orders, use that saved order instead of the initial sort. Once a user has reordered technician groups/columns, use their saved order instead of the initial technician sort.”
  • S9-R11: “Save the manual order of work orders once per location. Everyone at the location sees the same order, in both Tech View and Board View. If two people reorder at the same time, the later save wins; the other person sees the saved order on their next refresh and is not warned.”
  • S9-R12: “The manual order of work orders stays until someone changes it. Technician group/column order and pins are saved per user (S9-R2, S3-R18).”

AUTOMATION: HOLD - not yet build-verified on the Work Orders QA build
